value.rationale: The minimal five-taxon negative-covariance threshold explains precisely when two widely used phylogenetic metrics can co-fluctuate in opposing directions under equal-richness sampling. A robust open negative region and large exact negative correlation give nonaccidental structure beyond a routine single calculation.
